changelog:
v1.25.6 - HUD overhaul + low-health feedback systems: (1) a floating player health bar above the player — identical build/styling to the enemy bars — that mirrors HP and auto-hides via an opacity fade (shown below 100% HP or for 3s after a hit); (2) a red peripheral screen vignette that fades in below 33% HP and pulses faster/brighter as HP approaches 0 (new `shaders/vignette_low_hp.gdshader`); (3) below 20% HP a synthesized looping heartbeat plus a low-pass "shock" muffle on a dedicated music bus, both eased in/out; (4) relocated the minimap to the top-right corner with the Cash/Kills counters stacked right-aligned beneath it — all corner-anchored so the HUD scales across resolutions. SoundManager gains a Music bus + runtime heartbeat synth. Verified: full headless PlayScene boot clean + dedicated assertions.
v1.25.5 - Player survivability pass (poison/DoT + rolling): all damage-over-time the player takes is now centrally rate-capped in `take_damage` — per type ≤ max_hp/30 per sec and all DoT combined ≤ max_hp/10 per sec (token buckets), and DoT can never deal the killing blow (it floors at 1 HP). Rolling now shakes off stun/slow/freeze (DoT and damage-reduction are kept), and a roll grants full invulnerability to hits, area effects and incoming debuffs for its duration (`apply_stun`/`apply_slow` and the status gate now respect `is_rolling`).
v1.25.4 - Remove the vestigial game-repo `version.json` (nothing read it — the launcher consumes the auto-synced `version.json` in the public launcher repo, and the bundled/installed copy is generated from the git tag at export time). Corrected architecture.md §3 Release Contract to describe the real, CI-synced contract; the git tag is the single source of truth for a release.
